events.label: Federal Reserve leadership terms and succession overview

slots.name: Board member count
slots.sentence: By law, the Fed chair must be separately confirmed as a member—often called a governor—of the seven-person Federal Reserve Board.

slots.name: governor term length
slots.sentence: The Fed governors serve fixed 14-year terms that are staggered; one term expires every two years.

slots.name: regional bank count
slots.sentence: The president and Senate have no say in picking presidents of the 12 regional Fed banks.
